dining_cutoff_hint: For example 30 or 60 minutes. Applies to every table at this location; 0 permits orders until closing. Staff can close an individual table menu.
dining_menu_paused: The team has closed this table menu. Ask them to reopen it before ordering.
booking_no_slots: No times available. Try another date or party size.
booking_availability_hint: Availability is checked again on submission. Times are local to the restaurant.

booking_manual_hint: The team confirms within the deadline shown after submission. Seats are held temporarily until then.
booking_missing_token: Open the email link or use the device on which you booked.
booking_unavailable: Reservation unavailable. Check your booking link.
dining_qr_explanation: The QR is permanent. Staff can close and reopen the table menu without replacing the code. Configure the ordering cutoff before venue closing in Settings.
dining_disabled: Table ordering is disabled. Enable it in restaurant setup.
dining_no_tables: Add tables in setup, then enable the service to generate QR codes.
dining_rotate_warning: Regeneration invalidates the old printed QR and closes the current session. Print the new QR.
dining_payment_hint: Pay at the restaurant. Your order is sent to the team for acceptance.
dining_scan_again: Scan the table QR again to start.
dining_session_ready: Table connected. You can place your order.
dining_staff_required: Staff must open the table session
dining_staff_policy: The QR accepts orders only while staff keep the table session open.
dining_static_policy: Anyone with the QR can start a session and order, including from outside the restaurant.

map_pick_hint: Click the map to mark the exact delivery location. You can move the pin.
map_load_error: The map could not initialize. Reload the page.
map_tiles_error: The map background did not load completely. Check the provider; geometry remains available.
map_delivery_policy: Draw one polygon per zone and set its fee and minimum in minor currency units. Lower numeric priority wins overlaps. If polygons exist, postal codes cannot bypass map eligibility.
map_outside: The pin is outside the delivery zones.
map_address_hint: The pin marks the delivery destination. Check the automatically filled address and edit it if needed. Coordinates are sent to the location service to identify the address.
map_first_vertex: Click to place the first vertex
map_finish_poly: Click the first vertex to close the zone

cuisine_photo_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · maximum 4 MB and 6000 × 6000 px. Leave empty when editing to keep the photo.

landing_faq_description: A few useful things before you start. No promises hidden in the small print.
landing_faq_services_question: Do I have to enable every service?
landing_faq_services_answer: No. At each location you can choose pickup, delivery, reservations and table QR orders independently. Configure what suits the way you work.
landing_faq_website_question: Can I publish a menu without a website?
landing_faq_website_answer: ZionFood includes a public menu with your restaurant’s identity. You do not need to build a separate website for that menu. A custom domain requires separate configuration.
landing_faq_qr_question: How do I stay in control of QR ordering?
landing_faq_qr_answer: Each table has a permanent QR code. Staff can close and reopen its menu. Ordering stops before venue closing according to your chosen cutoff, such as 30 or 60 minutes.
landing_faq_payments_question: Can I collect online payments now?
landing_faq_payments_answer: Not yet. Online payment processing and reservation deposits are in preparation. The Payments menu is currently informational and does not collect payments.
landing_faq_start_answer: Create an account and follow the guided setup for your restaurant, tables, menu and services. Onboarding includes a 14-day trial. The interface is available in Romanian and English.
landing_closing_description: Bring your menu, guests and team onto the same page. Start with what you need today.
landing_footer_tagline: One place for your menu, guests and team.
restaurant_map_hint: Click the map or drag the pin to adjust the restaurant entrance.
restaurant_location_intro: Uses the address, city and country entered above.
restaurant_location_not_found: We could not find this address. Check the street, number and city, add the postcode or place the pin directly on the map.
restaurant_location_found: Address located. Check the pin and save this step.
restaurant_location_approximate: We found an approximate position. Add the street number for a more precise search or move the pin to the restaurant entrance.
restaurant_location_choose: We found several matches. Choose the correct address below.
restaurant_location_adjusted: Pin adjusted. Save this step to keep the location.

restaurant_location_provider: Address search sends the address; using the pin sends its position to the search service. Geographic data:

ingredients_catalog_hint: Shared ingredients are managed by platform administrators. Restaurants can manage their own ingredients. Imported PDF flags follow occurrence counts; ties keep the flag enabled. An unchecked flag does not certify the absence of allergens: check the recipe and supplier information.
ingredients_remove_hint: This ingredient will no longer be selectable for new recipes. Existing recipes retain their information and flags. Continue?
ingredients_retained: This recipe contains hidden or removed ingredients. They are retained to inform customers; you can explicitly remove them from the recipe.
ingredients_product_hint: Ingredient flags apply to the product automatically. Also mark the product if it has additional allergens or frozen components.
product_portion_hint: For example: 350 g, 200/250 g or 250 ml
ingredients_none_found: No ingredient found. Add your own ingredients through Manage ingredients.
checkout_address_loading: Finding the address at the pin…
checkout_address_filled: Address filled from the pin. Check and edit the details if needed.
checkout_address_partial: An approximate address was found. Check the street, number and city in the field above.
checkout_address_manual: The full address could not be retrieved. Enter or check the street, number and city manually.
checkout_minimum: The minimum order for this area is {total}.

frozen_marker: ** Marked ingredients may come from frozen products.

allergen_group_12: Sulphur dioxide and sulphites above 10 mg/kg or 10 mg/l
storefront_share_cta: Discover the menu and choose your favourite dish!
store_choose_location_hint: Select the location whose menu you want to browse or order from.
dining_reason_service_disabled: This restaurant has not enabled QR table ordering. You can browse the public menu and ask the restaurant team to take your order.
dining_reason_table_closed: The restaurant team has closed ordering for this table. The QR remains valid and will work again once the table menu is reopened.
dining_ask_team: Please contact a member of the restaurant team for assistance.
dining_open_disabled: Table ordering is disabled for this location. An administrator must enable it in Restaurant setup → Services. Rotating the QR does not enable the service.
dining_action_busy: Saving the change. Please wait before performing another action.
company_lookup_hint: Enter the CUI to retrieve public ANAF data. Review the results and save the form; policies must be completed manually. No API key is required.
company_edited: You edited the form during the lookup. Your data was not overwritten; you can look up again.
company_not_found: Company not found in ANAF. Check the CUI or complete the details manually.
company_loaded: ANAF details retrieved. Review them, complete missing fields and save.
invitation_register_hint: Your emailed invitation confirms this address. After registration you will enter the restaurant with the access granted by its administrator.
invitation_join_hint: Create an account with the invited address or sign in. The invitation verifies the email; no separate verification is needed.
permissions_read_only: You have view-only access. Editing a menu shared by multiple locations requires access to every affected location.
dining_bulk_confirm_all: This closes the menus and sessions of all tables at this location. Existing orders remain unchanged.
dining_bulk_confirm_area: This closes table menus and sessions in “{area}”. Existing orders remain unchanged.
dining_effective_closed: QR is not accepting orders now
dining_manual_paused: The table is disabled by the team.
dining_manual_active: The table is enabled by the team.
dining_manual_vs_window: Enabling a table does not extend ordering hours. The card status and border show effective QR availability.
dining_reason_outside_hours: Table ordering is unavailable outside restaurant hours. Staff may enable the table, but the QR accepts orders only within the permitted window.
dining_reason_cutoff: New table orders have stopped at the configured cutoff before restaurant closing. The table is enabled but cannot accept new orders during this period.
dining_reason_staff_activation: The restaurant team needs to activate a session for this table.
mc_intro: Allergens, labels, recipes and translations stored with your restaurant.
mc_provider_hint: Groq is the initial free-plan option. Availability and limits depend on your provider account. There is no automatic paid fallback.
mc_api_key: API key — leave empty to keep the current key
mc_groq_models: Supported Groq models: openai/gpt-oss-20b and openai/gpt-oss-120b. Check availability in your account.
mc_daily_limit: Total product requests per 24 hours — all restaurants
mc_data_sent: AI receives the supplied text, ingredients, portion weight and preparation details. We do not send customer, order or payment data. Nutrition is estimated and requires review.
mc_food_hint: Use the recipe and supplier information. An unchecked box does not guarantee allergen absence; dietary labels need verification.
mc_reference: Reference: supplier sheet, label or verified database
mc_translation_hint: Romanian remains the source. Every translation can be edited. Source changes hide stale translations from the public menu until updated. Menu languages are separate from interface language.
mc_ai_hint: Translations, suggestions and rewrites are saved as proposals. Choose what to approve or edit before publishing.
mc_ai_unconfigured: The platform administrator must configure and enable the AI provider.
mc_three_languages: Up to three languages per request; repeat for more languages.
mc_no_drafts: No proposals for this dish yet.
mc_stale_draft: The dish changed. Generate a fresh proposal before approving.
mc_save_first: Save your changes before starting this operation.
mc_rewrite_review: This proposal changes the source description. Confirm it here, then refine it in the regular product editor.
mc_error_ai_not_configured: AI is no longer enabled or configured.
mc_error_ai_rate_limited: Provider usage limit reached. Try later.
mc_error_ai_incomplete: AI response is incomplete. Nothing was published.
mc_error_ai_provider_failed: AI provider could not process the request.
mc_error_generation_failed: Generation did not pass validation. Nothing was published.
auto_intro: Choose a dish. We prepare its information. You review and choose what goes on your menu.
auto_no_description: Add a description for better results.
auto_inputs_hint: Just ingredients and final weight. No manual calculations.
auto_one_portion_hint: Finished weight after cooking. Calculations always use one portion.
auto_ingredients_example: For example: feta cheese, tomatoes, olive oil, oregano
auto_ingredients_hint: Filled from the dish. Add analysis details here; edit the public ingredient list using “Edit dish”.
auto_preparation_example: For example: oven-baked, no added oil
auto_tasks_hint: Select what you need. Receive one proposal to review.
auto_nutrition_hint: Automatic estimates per portion and per 100 g.
auto_food_hint: Ingredient-based suggestions to check before publication.
auto_rewrite_hint: Rewrite in Romanian, preserving the dish’s facts.
auto_translate_hint: Translations saved locally in your chosen languages.
auto_language_hint: Romanian is the source. Up to 3 languages per generation.
auto_pick_task: Choose at least one generation option.
auto_missing: For nutrition, enter the portion weight and ingredients.
auto_review_first: Nothing is published automatically. Review and approve only what you want.
auto_background: Keep working in the app. We will notify you when the result is ready; click the notification to review it.
auto_no_history: No generations for this dish yet.
auto_estimate_notice: AI estimates based on the supplied ingredients and weight. Actual proportions and preparation may change the result. These are not laboratory measurements; review before publishing.
auto_stale: The dish changed after generation. Generate again before publishing.
auto_failed: Generation failed. Nothing was published. Try again from the generation page.
auto_none_suggested: No suggestions in this section. Absence does not guarantee allergen-free food.
auto_empty_hint: Add products to your menu, then return for automatic generation.
auto_nothing_published: No generated information has been published yet.
auto_read_only: You have view access. A colleague with management permission can generate and publish.
mc_ai_unavailable: AI generation is not enabled. The platform administrator must configure a provider; published data remains available.
auto_bulk_hint: Translate the location’s saved products into up to 3 languages. Each dish gets its own proposal and notification. Processing respects the shared AI queue and budget; nothing is published automatically.
auto_manual_hint: Correct allergens, labels and existing translations here. Review generated nutrition from its result. Changes here are published only when saved.
field_help_generic: Enter the value you want the app to use for {field}. Follow the displayed limits; changes are validated when saved.
field_help_secret: Confidential data. Use a valid value and do not share it. In settings forms, follow the instructions for retaining or replacing an existing key.
field_help_cui: Enter the company CUI, optionally prefixed with RO. Lookup retrieves available data; review it before saving.
field_help_email: Use a valid email address. Depending on the form, invitations, confirmations or account messages are sent here.
field_help_phone: Enter the contact number, preferably with country code, so the restaurant can contact the right person.
field_help_language: Choose the display language. Interface language is separate from menu translations; missing text falls back to the source language.
field_help_timezone: Choose the location time zone. Opening hours, reservations and daily statistics use this time zone.
field_help_coordinates: Coordinates identify the map position. Use the pin or locate action where available and check the selected place.
field_help_postal: Enter the address postal code. It helps locate the address and may be used by delivery rules.
field_help_city: Enter the town or city, without street or building number, to help locate the correct map pin.
field_help_country: Choose the address country. It provides context for maps, company details and contact formats.
field_help_address: Enter street, building number and town. If a map is available, retrieve the pin address and edit it afterwards.
field_help_nutrition: Nutrition values use the displayed unit and basis. AI estimates require review and are not laboratory measurements.
field_help_weight: Enter the finished weight of one portion in grams. Nutrition generation always uses one portion after cooking.
field_help_ingredients: Include the dish’s actual ingredients. Public ingredients and AI analysis text serve different purposes; do not omit relevant ingredients.
field_help_allergens: Select known allergens or possible traces as applicable. Check the recipe and suppliers; an empty selection does not guarantee absence of allergens.
field_help_frozen: Enable if the ingredient or product may originate from frozen products. The indication appears in public dish information.
field_help_diet: Choose only dietary labels supported by the recipe and supplier information. Review AI suggestions before publication.
field_help_money: Enter the amount in the displayed currency. Check whether it is a price, fee or minimum; order totals are calculated on the server.
field_help_tax: Configure tax according to the restaurant’s situation and the displayed unit. Review the value before publishing prices.
field_help_duration: Enter the duration in the displayed unit, usually minutes. It controls the interval, preparation time or pre-closing order cutoff.
field_help_schedule: Choose the date or time in the location’s time zone. Follow available hours and check both interval endpoints.
field_help_capacity: Enter the actual number of guests or seats. Table and room capacity is used to validate reservations.
field_help_permissions: Choose what the employee may view or change. No access hides the section; view-only prevents changes. Owner access is preserved.
field_help_locations: Select the locations affected by access or configuration. Other locations remain protected by permissions.
field_help_limits: Choose the allowed limit in the displayed interval or unit. The AI rolling 24-hour budget is shared by all restaurants.
field_help_provider: Choose a provider and compatible model. Generation uses the stored key and account limits; providers never switch automatically.
field_help_url: Enter a complete address and check the destination. Integrations and webhooks may require HTTPS and separate access configuration.
field_help_image: Choose a clear image in an accepted format. Check the preview and file limits; logos and dish photos serve different purposes.
field_help_branding: Customize the restaurant’s visual identity. Check readability and contrast in the public menu preview.
field_help_quantity: Enter the desired number within the displayed limits. Cart quantity affects the total and available selections.
field_help_options: Configure or choose dish variants and options. Respect required choices and minimum/maximum selection limits.
field_help_enabled: Enable or disable this option. Other rules, opening hours and permissions continue to apply.
field_help_status: Choose an allowed state for the current operation. Changes may update the workflow and team notifications.
field_help_search: Type to narrow the displayed list. Searching or filtering does not change saved data.
field_help_description: Write clear and accurate details. Keep relevant dish or operation information; public text is visible to customers.
field_help_classification: Choose the appropriate menu, category or cuisine. This organization helps customers find dishes.
field_help_policy: Configure the policy the restaurant will communicate and apply. Check terms and deadlines before saving.
field_help_name: Use a clear, recognizable name. Follow the displayed length limit and avoid confusing duplicates.
dining_reason_open: The table can receive orders: the service is enabled, staff have not paused its menu and the ordering window is open.
dining_reason_location_paused: The location has temporarily paused orders.
dining_reason_no_hours: No opening interval is configured for the current time.
dining_reason_closed: The restaurant is not receiving orders during this interval.
dining_reason_paused: The location has temporarily paused orders.
tables_bulk_help: Choose all tables or one room, then open or close the selected menus. Closing requires confirmation. Hours and service rules still apply.
tables_scope_help: The action affects only active tables in the selected room, or all active tables at this location. QR codes stay unchanged.
dash_period_help: Includes today and uses the location time zone. Data is limited to the selected location and sections you may access.
dash_orders_help: Orders placed in the selected period, including cancelled or rejected orders.
dash_value_help: Total value of completed orders placed in the selected period. This is not confirmed cash receipts or a payment report.
dash_average_help: Completed order value divided by their count. Cancelled and rejected orders are excluded.
dash_recipes_help: Products in menus attached to this location. Each product counts once, regardless of variants.
dash_reservations_help: Reservations starting in the selected period, grouped by status below.
dash_guests_help: Guests in reservations excluding cancelled, rejected, expired or no-show records. This is not confirmed physical attendance.
dash_capacity_help: Total seats across active tables in this location’s configuration.
dash_visits_help: Approximate visits, deduplicated for 30 minutes for the same connection/browser profile. These are not unique people; no visitor IPs or identifiers are stored in the database.
dash_qr_sessions: tables with an active QR session
dash_qr_help: QR sessions that are neither closed nor expired. An active session does not prove physical occupancy.
dash_chart_help: Switch between orders placed and completed order value. Hover over points for exact values.
dash_top_help: Ranked by portions in completed orders, using immutable order data.
dash_no_completed: Rankings appear after the first completed orders.
dash_no_reservations: No reservations in the selected period.
dash_top_tables_help: Completed table orders in the selected period. Table names come from order snapshots.
dash_tracking_new: Tracking begins with this version. No past visits are backfilled.
auto_published_success: The result was saved and published.
tables_qr_short: Permanent QR · staff and schedule controls
